story.titleZh: 瓦塞尔：法拉利车手墨西哥内斗越界
story.summaryZh: 墨西哥大奖赛首圈，汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔为争胜互相缠斗，葬送了法拉利包揽前二的大好局面，将胜利拱手让给维斯塔潘和红牛。瓦塞尔表示，这次内斗与赞德沃特和蒙扎不同，已经越过了此前未曾触碰的底线。
story.originalTitle: Where Ferrari drivers' Mexico clash crossed a new line
story.summaryEn: On the opening lap of the Mexican Grand Prix, Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc battled each other so hard that Ferrari's 1-2 was wasted and victory was gifted to Max Verstappen and Red Bull. Fred Vasseur said this clash, unlike those at Zandvoort and Monza, crossed a line that had not been transgressed before.
detailZh: 墨西哥大奖赛首圈，刘易斯·汉密尔顿与夏尔·勒克莱尔之间的冲突，并不是法拉利F1车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔今年第一次处理手下两位车手之间的摩擦。
但与赞德沃特和蒙扎不同，这一次越过了瓦塞尔此前未曾被触碰的底线。
在一条超车极其困难的赛道上，法拉利首圈便有两辆赛车占据前列，完全有能力取得本赛季最佳成绩。
然而，它的车手搞砸了，把胜利拱手让给了马克斯·维斯塔潘和红牛。
瓦塞尔事后哀叹道：“我们在4号弯时处于1-2的位置。我不记得墨西哥上一次超车是什么时候了，也许是70年代末。当你在4号弯处于1-2时，你不会想到自己会赢不了比赛。”
对于瓦塞尔来说，他对失去胜利的沮丧并不在于车手们在通过前几个弯道时谁对谁错，最终导致勒克莱尔在4号弯和5号弯之间横穿赛道，而汉密尔顿则跑宽了。
相反，问题要深得多——车手们为了争夺胜利而如此激烈地互相争斗的自身利益，最终浪费了马拉内罗所有人在最近几场比赛中为提高赛车竞争力所付出的努力，而正是这些努力才让赛车首先来到前列。
而在这个问题上，瓦塞尔说这变成了一个尊重的问题。
正如他在方格旗挥动后对Canal+所说：“我很难咽下这口气。这是对所有工作人员的不尊重。浪费一场胜利很难受。它卡在我的喉咙里。他们不是在为自己比赛。”
对于不愿卷入事件具体细节的瓦塞尔来说，这是车手将个人利益置于车队利益之上的情况之一。
在法拉利的赛后新闻稿中，他说：“我一直期望每个人都能尊重品牌、车队、我们的合作伙伴，最重要的是，尊重为我们在家乡工作的2000名员工。”
“他们为我们的工作投入了难以置信的努力，在工厂日夜工作以改进赛车并为赛道带来升级。这就是为什么以这种方式错失胜利难以接受。”
强调团队合作精神这一点也得到了汉密尔顿本人的呼应——他认为自己和勒克莱尔并没有像他们本应做到的那样良好协作。
“需要记住的核心一点，也许随着年龄增长才会明白，就是你在车里做出的每一个决定都会影响整个车队在幕后工作的所有人，”汉密尔顿在赛后说道。
“我们合同的一部分就是我们必须作为一个团队协作，今天我们本可以轻松做到这一点。所以看到我们像那样输掉比赛，真的很遗憾。
“而且除非采取行动、进行真正深入严肃的对话，否则这种情况还会继续下去，所以这种事不应该再在未来发生。”
瓦塞尔表示，他需要一些时间来“消化”第一圈发生的情况，但他清楚，绝不能让类似事件重演。
正因如此，他认为墨西哥站发生的事情值得与车手们坐下来谈一谈，以便在下周末巴西站比赛恢复前“澄清局面”。
在分别与汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔沟通之前，瓦塞尔不愿就他认为谁的责任更大发表看法。
但他觉得，距离注意力转向英特拉格斯赛道比赛只剩几天反而是件好事，这样就不会留出空隙让问题发酵。
“优势在于我们四天后还有一场比赛，”瓦塞尔说。“我们今晚会讨论，明天会解决，然后我们会专注于这一场。”
勒克莱尔在赛后表示，他认为没有必要就发生的事情进行任何重大对话，而汉密尔顿则表示他不确定理想的结果是什么。
汉密尔顿过去曾谈到需要制定交战规则，但他并不认为引入这些规则会有多大区别。
“我不知道现在需要发生什么，”他说。“我们回去后如何讨论事情，我不太确定我想如何参与其中。”
他补充道：“当你的队友与你作对，然后你就那样丢掉位置时，这绝对很难受。所以我们会在私下里谈这件事，多说其实也没什么意义。”
“我们没有交战规则，至于这是否会改变查尔斯那边的任何情况，我不知道。我们得把这件事弄清楚，但肯定需要有所改变。”
勒克莱尔觉得汉密尔顿在那次事件中和他一样激进。
“我们显然会谈这件事，”他说。“我不知道他是否对我的做法很不满，因为我觉得他做的事也相当接近极限。”
“我认为他可能对整个情况更生气，对4-5号弯的情况处理方式、罚时等等更生气。这肯定是我们会讨论的事情。”
但是，无论瓦塞尔在巴西大奖赛前如何立下规矩让他的车手们守规矩，很明显两人之间的紧张关系已经升级，而且似乎没有多少信任。
虽然汉密尔顿并非完全无辜，因为他在4/5号弯事故中刹车过晚并跑宽，帮助维斯塔潘通过，但他认为整件事最终是由勒克莱尔不必要地攻击他引发的。
“如果我从后面来，承担所有风险，最终我们作为车队输了，那我认为我得做出一些交代，因为这会影响很多人，”这位七届冠军说道。
“但反过来，我处于领先位置，这完全没有必要。我认为我们本可以轻松拿到那个第一和第二名，这对车队以及工厂里所有为给我们带来这些升级而辛勤工作的人来说，都会是巨大的成就。”
“所以我真的不知道会采取什么措施，因为到目前为止，实际上什么都没有做。”
而且，这明显是在暗讽队友的态度，汉密尔顿认为勒克莱尔对待比赛的方式是错误的，同时他否认是缺乏经验或年龄导致了这些情况。
“这家伙已经28岁了，所以我不认为这是年龄的问题，”他说。“我认为这是心态问题。就像是‘要么做要么死——要么我赢，要么我们谁都别赢’，不应该这样。应该是我们拿到那个第一和第二名。”
“在银石赛道，我本可以对他采取那种玩命式的动作，把他撞出赛道，从而让我们丢掉冠军，但最终我们拿到了第一和第三。我很高兴车队经历了那样的时刻。”
“但我希望我们能在未来朝着更好的方向努力，营造一个更好的工作环境。”
detailEn: The Mexican Grand Prix first lap run-in between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc is not the first time Ferrari Formula 1 team principal Fred Vasseur has had to deal with fallout between his drivers this year.
But unlike Zandvoort and Monza, this one crossed a line for Vasseur that had not been transgressed before.
With two cars at the front of the field on the opening lap at a track where overtaking is super difficult, Ferrari had everything in its power to achieve its best result of the season.
Instead, its drivers blew it and gifted Max Verstappen and Red Bull the victory.

Vasseur lamented afterwards: "We were 1-2 at Turn 4. I don't remember the last overtaking in Mexico, perhaps at the end of the '70s. When you are 1-2 in Turn 4, you don't imagine that you won't win the race."

For Vasseur, his frustration about losing the win was not about who was in the right or wrong with their positioning through the first corners, which ultimately ended up with Leclerc cutting across the track between Turns 4 and 5 and Hamilton running wide.

Instead, the issue ran much deeper - in that the self interest of the drivers to battle each other so hard for the win ended up wasting the efforts of everyone at Maranello who had worked to lift the competitiveness of the car over recent races to get it to the front in the first place.
And on that matter, Vasseur said it became a question of respect.

As he told Canal+ after the chequered flag: "I'm having trouble swallowing it. It's a lack of respect for all the people who work. Wasting a victory is hard. It's stuck in my throat. They're not racing for themselves."
For Vasseur, who did not want to get involved in the specifics of the incident, this was one of those cases of drivers putting their own interests in front of those of the team.
In Ferrari's post-race press release he said: "I always expect everyone to show respect for the brand, the team, our partners and, above all, the 2000 people working for us back home.

"They put an incredible amount of effort into what we do, working day and night at the factory to improve the car and bring upgrades to the track. That's why missing out on a win in this way is difficult to accept."
The emphasis of being a team player was something echoed by Hamilton himself - who reckoned that he and Leclerc had not worked together as well as they should have done.

"The core thing to remember, which maybe comes with age, is that every decision you make in the car impacts all the people that work in the background for the whole team," Hamilton said after the race.
"A part of our contract is we have to work as a team, which we could have easily done today. So it's a shame to see us lose as we did.
"And that will continue unless action is taken, and a real deep, serious conversation is had, so it shouldn't happen moving forward."
While Vasseur said that he needed some time to "digest" what had happened on the first lap, he knows that a repeat cannot be allowed.
That is why he thought what happened in Mexico warrants a sit down with his drivers to "clear the situation" ahead of action resuming in Brazil next weekend.
Vasseur did not want to get drawn into his views on who he felt was more at fault until he had spoken to both Hamilton and Leclerc.
But he felt that there only being a few days to go before attention shifted to the Interlagos race was a benefit in terms of there not being a gap where things could fester.
"The advantage is that we have another one in four days," said Vasseur. "We'll discuss tonight, we'll fix it tomorrow, and then we'll do this one."
Leclerc suggested post-race that he did not see the need for any major conversation over what happened, while Hamilton said he was unsure of an ideal outcome.
Hamilton has talked in the past of the need for rules of engagement, but he is not convinced introducing them will make much of a difference.
"I don't know what needs to happen now," he said. "How we discuss things when we go back, I'm not quite sure how I want to engage in that."
He added: "When your team-mate works against you and then you lose positions like that, it's definitely tough. So we'll just talk about it offline, and it's not really worth saying too much more.
"We don't have rules of engagement, and whether or not that will change anything from Charles' side, I don't know. We've just got to figure it out, but something needs to change for sure."
Leclerc felt that Hamilton had been just as aggressive as he was in the incident.
"We will talk about it, obviously," he said. "I don't know if he was very unhappy with what I did, because I felt like it was very much on the limit, also, what he did.
"I think he was maybe more angry with the whole situation, how the situation was dealt in [Turns] 4-5, with the penalty, etc. This is something we'll talk about for sure."

But however much Vasseur lays down the law ahead of the Brazilian GP to get his drivers in line, it is clear that tensions have escalated between the pair of them and that there does not seem to be much trust.

While Hamilton was not totally innocent because he braked late and ran wide in the Turn 4/5 incident to help Verstappen come through, he thought the whole thing was ultimately triggered by Leclerc unnecessarily attacking him.

"If I'm coming from behind and I'm taking all the risk, and it ends up we lose as a team, then I think I would have some answering to do because it impacts a lot of people," said the seven-time champion.

"But the other way round, I'm in the lead, and it was just unnecessary. I think we could have easily had that 1-2, which would have been huge for the team and for everyone back at the factory who's worked so hard to bring us these upgrades.
"So I don't really know what will be done because up until now nothing really has been done."
And in a clear dig at his team-mate's attitude, Hamilton reckoned Leclerc was approaching racing wrongly, as he denied it was inexperience or age that was causing these situations.

"The guy's 28 years old, so I don't think it's an age thing," he said. "I think it's a mentality thing. It's like 'do or die - either I win or none of us do', and it shouldn't be that. It should be us getting that 1-2.
"At Silverstone, I could have gone all kamikaze on him and taken him off, and lost us the win, but instead it was a 1-3. I'm happy for the team to have experienced that.
"But I'm hopeful we'll work towards a better place, a better working place in future."
keyPointsZh: 法拉利在首圈第4弯时占据前二，而墨西哥赛道超车极为困难。
瓦塞尔赛后表示难以接受，认为这关乎尊重问题。
keyPointsEn: Ferrari was 1-2 at Turn 4 on the opening lap at a track where overtaking is extremely difficult.
Vasseur said afterwards he was having trouble swallowing it and that it became a question of respect.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
